title: About
blocks: Natasha & Co. is an ISO 9001: 2015 Certified Chartered Accountant firm based in Bhopal and operating in various regions within India as well as overseas. The company started their operations in 2017 under the effective management of CA Natasha Rajvaidya. Over the years promoter has developed the platform for several professional such as CA, CS, IT, Lawyer and specialized field experts, who have vast experience in their respective fields, the company hires top notch professionals and apply modern managerial techniques for attaining best corporate governance practice’s and with efficient managerial abilities.
